correctness.rationale: From [(A,u),(B,v)]=0, B must commute with A and Av=Bu. For k=dim ker A, the kernel dimension is c(A)+k-rank(Phi_u) on the centralizer C(A), with Phi_u(B)=Bu mod im A. An occupied largest top component in a zero-primary size-L Jordan block generates exactly the quotient-top directions of block sizes <=L (t_L). Counts of vectors by maximal occupied zero-block size yield q^(n-k+h_s)(q^b_s-1); standard rational-canonical class centralizer formulas give complete enumerator. Reconstructed the n=3 q=2 rank multiplicities [1,15,98,154,532,1064,2232] totaling 4096 and commuting ordered-pair count 86080; reviewed exact seventeen-stratum derivation code. General assertion is module-theoretic, not finite-experiment extrapolation.
